title: Process a course drop with refund
steps: Verify identity (POL-101 1.4) | Check the drop date against the refund schedule | Submit the drop in the student system | Note the refund amount in the student record

title: Approve late registration
steps: Confirm the class has started | Get instructor approval on form F-115 | Register the student | Email the student a confirmation

title: Refer a student for accommodations
steps: Listen without asking about a diagnosis | Share the DSS contact and hours | Offer to walk the student to DSS or book an appointment

title: Help a student apply for an emergency grant
steps: Confirm current enrollment | Share form F-520 | Check the campus for pilot limits | Send the form to the Dean of Students office

title: Release a record to a parent
steps: Verify the student's consent on form F-210 | Verify the parent's identity | Release only the items listed on the form
